verdict.rationale: YYLO accepts a plain-language task description (`yylo init --task "Describe one verifiable outcome"`, `yy ledger create`). It can also pull Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban, and `task start` gives each task its own branch and worktree. However, the developer writes the task scope by hand: nothing shows natural-language intent being automatically turned into a scoped specification. Missing for 10: automatic conversion of a feature or bug description into a scoped spec or implementation task, generated acceptance criteria or task breakdown, and hands-on corroboration.
